spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_true_shape.de: Cast off the pretence: a gaunt, winged horror, hitting harder and taking more than you ever do, with one more jump in the air. By hand it tears what is softer than stone. No armour and no tools while it lasts, and it drinks your blood fast; with none left it is over. Folk scream and run. Costs 500 mB. Use it again to turn back. Each pact you keep makes it a little stronger.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_barrier.name: Blood Barrier
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_barrier.descr: Three rings of your blood circle you for a while. Each soaks one blow, and a heavy blow breaks two. Costs 350 mB.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_batstep.name: Batstep
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_batstep.descr: A short blink, about eight blocks, to where you look, in a burst of bats. Anything you pass through is hurt and staggered. Costs 250 mB.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.night_flechettes.de: A fan of up to five shards of your own blood, each one paid for out of your reserve (40 mB a shard; you keep 100). A creature a shard hits cannot heal for a while, and your next blow on it gives a little blood back. Players only where players may fight.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.true_shape: The fifth shape: a winged horror.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.barrier: Three rings of blood soak blows.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.batstep: Blink in a burst of bats.
A Colony leaves five bats circling you for a while. Whatever you hit, or whatever hits you, a bat latches on and drinks, and the drink comes back to you as blood.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.long_hold.desc: Your Stare holds much longer, less on a strong will, and the held follow you and stand with you in a fight.
Mist slips through doors, gates, trapdoors, bars and panes, takes no fall damage, and the first blow you strike out of it lands double.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.true: A winged horror; Jump again in the air.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.flec: Shards of blood, paid in mB each.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.horror.cry.1: Gods above, what is that thing?!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.horror.cry.2: Keep away from me! Keep away!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.horror.cry.3: The night has come for us!
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.290: A vampire of old blood can take the True Shape: a winged horror that hits harder, takes more, jumps once more in the air and tears what is softer than stone. It drinks blood fast, and folk scream and run.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.291: The Blood Barrier circles three rings of blood round you; each soaks a blow, and a heavy blow breaks two.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.292: Batstep blinks you eight blocks along your look in a burst of bats, hurting and staggering whatever you pass through.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.293: Each Blood Flechette shard costs blood of its own. What one hits cannot heal for a while, and your next blow on it gives some blood back.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.294: With the Hungry Colony, your bats drink from whatever you hit or whatever hits you, and what they drink comes back to you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.295: The Long Hold keeps a person in your stare far longer, and they will stand with you in a fight. A strong will shortens it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.296: Slipping Mist passes through doors, gates, trapdoors, bars and panes, and the first blow struck out of it lands double.
